#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds "System Toolbox.app" on a Mac (Apple Silicon and Intel in one universal app).
# Needs Rust: https://rustup.rs  (curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh)
# Run from the app folder:  bash tools/build-macos.sh
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."

rustup target add aarch64-apple-darwin x86_64-apple-darwin
cargo build --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin
cargo build --release --target x86_64-apple-darwin

APP="dist/System Toolbox.app"
rm -rf "$APP"
mkdir -p "$APP/Contents/MacOS" "$APP/Contents/Resources"
lipo -create \
  target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/system_toolbox \
  target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release/system_toolbox \
  -output "$APP/Contents/MacOS/System Toolbox"

cat > "$APP/Contents/Info.plist" <<'PLIST'
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
  <key>CFBundleName</key><string>System Toolbox</string>
  <key>CFBundleDisplayName</key><string>System Toolbox</string>
  <key>CFBundleIdentifier</key><string>app.systemtoolbox.desktop</string>
  <key>CFBundleVersion</key><string>13.0.0</string>
  <key>CFBundleShortVersionString</key><string>13.0</string>
  <key>CFBundleExecutable</key><string>System Toolbox</string>
  <key>CFBundlePackageType</key><string>APPL</string>
  <key>LSMinimumSystemVersion</key><string>11.0</string>
  <key>LSApplicationCategoryType</key><string>public.app-category.utilities</string>
  <key>NSHighResolutionCapable</key><true/>
  <key>NSRequiresAquaSystemAppearance</key><false/>
</dict>
</plist>
PLIST

# Ad-hoc signature so Gatekeeper lets it start locally (right-click > Open the first time).
codesign --force --deep --sign - "$APP" || true
echo "Done: $APP"

# System Toolbox 13.0

A modern, English-language system utility for **Windows and macOS**, built with Rust + egui.

Pages: Overview (CPU, memory, storage, uptime, device details, per-core load), Processes
(search, sort, end task), Cleanup (temporary files, crash reports, caches, Trash), Network
(adapters, addresses, live traffic), Quick tools (opens the system's own utilities) and
Settings (System/Light/Dark theme, accent colour, interface size, refresh rate).

## Windows

    cargo build --release
    target\release\system_toolbox.exe

This computer uses the GNU Rust toolchain; `tools/install-rust.ps1` and
`tools/install-mingw.ps1` set it up, and `.cargo/config.toml` points at the MinGW `dlltool`.
With Visual Studio's C++ tools (MSVC toolchain) no extra setup is needed.

## macOS

    bash tools/build-macos.sh

creates `dist/System Toolbox.app` (universal: Apple Silicon + Intel). The first time,
right-click the app and choose **Open**, because it is not notarised.

## Options

    --screenshot <file.png>   draw ~120 frames, save the window as PNG, exit
    --page <overview|processes|cleanup|network|tools|settings>
    --theme <system|light|dark>

# HoloFan Studio 13.0

Control and program 3D hologram fans on **Windows and macOS** (Rust + egui), in English
and with a modern look.

- **Player**: previous / single loop / play-pause / list loop / next, power, brightness ±,
  image alignment (CW / CCW), picture play time (5–30 s), device status and activity log.
- **Media & SD card**: playlist of videos and pictures (add, drop, reorder, remove),
  "Prepare videos" (square MP4 sized for the fan; needs ffmpeg), upload to the fan, and
  saving the playlist plus `playlist.txt` / `settings.txt` to an SD card or folder.
- **Clock**: clock on/off, white or black hands, Digital / Symbol / Zodiac / Constellation
  dial, power-on display time (h/min/s).
- **Device**: the 20 fan models (10-ND … 115-F6), connection address, Wi-Fi setup,
  clear cache, format fan storage, theme and accent colour.

**Not known yet:** the fan's real network protocol and video file format. The app sends
simple text commands over TCP to the address on the Device page (default
192.168.4.1:5000) and writes ordinary files to the SD card. Change `src/device.rs`
(`Cmd::wire`, `send_files`) and `src/media.rs` once the real format is known.

    cargo build --release
    target\release\holofan_studio.exe

This computer uses the GNU Rust toolchain; `tools/install-rust.ps1` and
`tools/install-mingw.ps1` set it up, and `.cargo/config.toml` points at the MinGW `dlltool`.

## macOS

    bash tools/build-macos.sh

creates `dist/HoloFan Studio.app` (Apple Silicon + Intel). The first time, right-click it
and choose **Open**, because it is not notarised.

    --screenshot <file.png>   draw ~120 frames, save the window as PNG, exit

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Builds "HoloFan Studio.app" and "HoloFan-Studio-13.0.dmg" on a Mac
# (one universal app for Apple Silicon and Intel).
#
# Needs Rust: https://rustup.rs
#   curl --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -sSf https://sh.rustup.rs | sh
# Then, in Terminal, from the app folder:
#   bash tools/build-macos.sh
# The results land in dist/. Open the .dmg and drag the app onto "Applications".
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")/.."

NAME="HoloFan Studio"
VERSION="13.0"
APP="dist/$NAME.app"
DMG="dist/HoloFan-Studio-$VERSION.dmg"

rustup target add aarch64-apple-darwin x86_64-apple-darwin
cargo build --release --target aarch64-apple-darwin
cargo build --release --target x86_64-apple-darwin

rm -rf "$APP" "$DMG"
mkdir -p "$APP/Contents/MacOS" "$APP/Contents/Resources"
lipo -create \
  target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/holofan_studio \
  target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release/holofan_studio \
  -output "$APP/Contents/MacOS/$NAME"

# App icon: the program draws its own icon; turn it into an .icns
ICONSET="$(mktemp -d)/AppIcon.iconset"
mkdir -p "$ICONSET"
BIN="target/aarch64-apple-darwin/release/holofan_studio"
[ "$(uname -m)" = "x86_64" ] && BIN="target/x86_64-apple-darwin/release/holofan_studio"
for s in 16 32 128 256 512; do
  "$BIN" --write-icon "$ICONSET/icon_${s}x${s}.png" "$s"
  "$BIN" --write-icon "$ICONSET/icon_${s}x${s}@2x.png" "$((s * 2))"
done
iconutil -c icns "$ICONSET" -o "$APP/Contents/Resources/AppIcon.icns"

cat > "$APP/Contents/Info.plist" <<PLIST
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE plist PUBLIC "-//Apple//DTD PLIST 1.0//EN" "http://www.apple.com/DTDs/PropertyList-1.0.dtd">
<plist version="1.0">
<dict>
  <key>CFBundleName</key><string>$NAME</string>
  <key>CFBundleDisplayName</key><string>$NAME</string>
  <key>CFBundleIdentifier</key><string>app.holofanstudio.desktop</string>
  <key>CFBundleVersion</key><string>13.0.0</string>
  <key>CFBundleShortVersionString</key><string>$VERSION</string>
  <key>CFBundleExecutable</key><string>$NAME</string>
  <key>CFBundleIconFile</key><string>AppIcon</string>
  <key>CFBundlePackageType</key><string>APPL</string>
  <key>LSMinimumSystemVersion</key><string>11.0</string>
  <key>LSApplicationCategoryType</key><string>public.app-category.utilities</string>
  <key>NSHighResolutionCapable</key><true/>
  <key>NSRequiresAquaSystemAppearance</key><false/>
  <key>NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription</key><string>HoloFan Studio connects to your hologram fan on the local network.</string>
  <key>NSRemovableVolumesUsageDescription</key><string>HoloFan Studio saves videos to the fan's SD card.</string>
</dict>
</plist>
PLIST

# Ad-hoc signature so Gatekeeper lets it start (right-click > Open the first time).
codesign --force --deep --sign - "$APP" || true

# Disk image with the app and a shortcut to Applications (drag to install).
STAGE="$(mktemp -d)/$NAME"
mkdir -p "$STAGE"
cp -R "$APP" "$STAGE/"
ln -s /Applications "$STAGE/Applications"
hdiutil create -volname "$NAME" -srcfolder "$STAGE" -ov -format UDZO "$DMG"

echo
echo "Done:"
echo "  App: $APP"
echo "  DMG: $DMG"

# Builds the finished Windows program and puts it in dist\HoloFan Studio.exe.
# Run from the app folder:  powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File tools\build-windows.ps1
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
Set-Location (Join-Path $PSScriptRoot '..')
$cargo = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.cargo\bin\cargo.exe'
if (-not (Test-Path $cargo)) { $cargo = 'cargo' }
& $cargo build --release
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force dist | Out-Null
Copy-Item target\release\holofan_studio.exe 'dist\HoloFan Studio.exe' -Force
"Done: $(Resolve-Path 'dist\HoloFan Studio.exe')"

import struct,sys
d=open(sys.argv[1],'rb').read()
def sz(o):
    # returns (value, newoffset) for sz_Or_Ord
    w=struct.unpack_from('<H',d,o)[0]
    if w==0xffff: return ('#%d'%struct.unpack_from('<H',d,o+2)[0], o+4)
    s=''
    while True:
        w=struct.unpack_from('<H',d,o)[0]; o+=2
        if w==0: break
        s+=chr(w)
    return (s,o)
def dlg(off,size):
    o=off
    ver,sig=struct.unpack_from('<HH',d,o)
    assert sig==0xffff, 'not ex'
    helpid,exs,style,n,x,y,cx,cy=struct.unpack_from('<IIIHhhhh',d,o+4); o+=26
    m,o=sz(o); c,o=sz(o); t,o=sz(o)

    if style & 0x40:

    for i in range(n):

        hid,ex,st,x,y,cx,cy,id_=struct.unpack_from('<IIIhhhhI',d,o); o+=24
        cl,o=sz(o); tx,o=sz(o)
